Abaddon.goal: Aphotic Shield dispels and absorbs, Borrowed Time heals from damage, Mist Coil heal/nuke.
Abaddon.requires: Shield timing (instant dispel), Borrowed Time awareness, Mist Coil targets.
Abaddon.fights: Shield allies being stunned, Borrowed Time when focused, Mist Coil to heal or damage.
Abaddon.dont: Shield after ally dies, let Borrowed Time get dispelled, Mist Coil at wrong time.
Abaddon.timings: Holy Locket or Vlads 12-15min for sustain, Solar Crest for carry buff.
Abaddon.gameStage: Early: trade with Shield, zone with Mist Coil. Mid: save hero with Shield dispel, push. Late: Borrowed Time bait, Shield dispels.

Alchemist.goal: Farm fastest with Greevil's Greed, gift Aghs to allies, Chemical Rage regen tank.
Alchemist.requires: Radiance timing, Aghs gifting priority, Chemical Rage uptime.
Alchemist.fights: Chemical Rage before fighting, acid for armor reduction, Concoction stun, tank with regen.
Alchemist.dont: Fight without Chemical Rage, farm jungle ignoring lanes, gift Aghs before own core items.
Alchemist.timings: Radiance 13-15min, first Aghs gift 25min. BKB+AC for fights.
Alchemist.gameStage: Early: farm mid/safe with Greed, stack camps. Mid: Radiance farm, Chemical Rage fights. Late: 12-slotted with Aghs gifts, frontline tank.

Ancient Apparition.goal: Ice Blast prevents healing globally, Cold Feet stun setup, Chilling Touch for range.
Ancient Apparition.requires: Ice Blast aim (global skillshot), Cold Feet stun setup (needs slow/stun), Vortex pull.
Ancient Apparition.fights: Ice Blast into teamfight (no healing), Cold Feet after ally stuns, Vortex to hold.
Ancient Apparition.dont: Ice Blast miss, Cold Feet without setup (they walk out), fight close range.
Ancient Apparition.timings: Aghs 25-28min for longer Ice Blast. Force Staff/Glimmer for survival.
Ancient Apparition.gameStage: Early: harass with Chilling Touch range, Cold Feet kills. Mid: global Ice Blast kills, anti-heal. Late: Ice Blast counters all healing lineups.

Anti-Mage.goal: Farm fast with Blink mobility, burn mana, punish low-mana heroes with Mana Void.
Anti-Mage.requires: Free safe lane farm, Battlefury timing, team creating space.
Anti-Mage.fights: Blink onto backline casters, Counterspell key spells, Mana Void when enemy mana pools are low.
Anti-Mage.dont: Fight before BF+Manta, Blink into multiple heroes, skip BKB when needed.
Anti-Mage.timings: Battlefury 14-16min, Manta 22-24min. Fight once you have Abyssal Blade.
Anti-Mage.gameStage: Early: last hit in safe lane, avoid fights. Mid: split push with Blink, farm triangle+lanes. Late: pick off casters, Mana Void teamfights.

Arc Warden.goal: Tempest Double creates full copy of yourself+items, Spark Wraith for zone, Flux for slow, Magnetic Field evasion.
Arc Warden.requires: Double management (use Double's items), Spark Wraith placement, Flux for 1v1.
Arc Warden.fights: Send Double to fight, stay safe, Spark Wraith for zone, Flux isolated targets, Magnetic Field for evasion.
Arc Warden.dont: Fight in person when Double can do it, Flux grouped enemies (purges when allies nearby), waste Double.
Arc Warden.timings: Midas 6-8min (Double doubles Midas), Maelstrom, Travels for Double push.
Arc Warden.gameStage: Early: mid farm, Flux harass. Mid: Double for pushing/fighting safely. Late: Double is a full second hero, split push and fight simultaneously.

Axe.goal: Initiate fights with Blink+Call, force enemies to attack you, execute low HP heroes with Culling Blade.
Axe.requires: Blink Dagger timing, lane dominance with Counter Helix spins, Blade Mail synergy.
Axe.fights: Blink+Call multiple heroes, Blade Mail during Call, Culling Blade to reset and chase.
Axe.dont: Call without Blade Mail ready, initiate without team follow-up, get kited without Blink.
Axe.timings: Blink 10-12min, Blade Mail right after. BKB by 22-25min for reliable initiation.
Axe.gameStage: Early: dominate offlane with Counter Helix, cut waves. Mid: Blink initiation, pick-offs. Late: frontline initiator, Call priority targets.

Bane.goal: Lock down key targets with Fiend's Grip, set up kills with Nightmare, reduce damage with Enfeeble.
Bane.requires: Safe positioning for full Grip channel, Nightmare saves on allies, vision for catches.
Bane.fights: Grip the biggest threat, Nightmare secondary targets, Enfeeble enemy carry.
Bane.dont: Grip without team nearby, Nightmare allies in danger accidentally, waste Grip on supports.
Bane.timings: Aether Lens 15-18min for safe Grip range. Aghs Shard for AoE Brain Sap sustain.
Bane.gameStage: Early: harass with Brain Sap, set up kills with Nightmare. Mid: smoke and Grip priority targets. Late: Grip enemy carry in fights, save allies with Nightmare.

Batrider.goal: Lasso drags enemies out of position (BKB-piercing), Sticky Napalm stacking damage, Flamebreak knockback.
Batrider.requires: Blink Lasso execution, Napalm stacking, Lasso target priority.
Batrider.fights: Blink+Lasso priority target, drag into team, Napalm stacks + Firefly for damage.
Batrider.dont: Lasso without team, Lasso supports over carry, miss Napalm stacks, skip Blink.
Batrider.timings: Blink 12-14min for Lasso, BKB 20-22min for safe Lasso. Force Staff to drag further.
Batrider.gameStage: Early: Napalm harass in lane, Firefly farm. Mid: Blink Lasso pickoffs. Late: Lasso carry into team, BKB-piercing grab.

Beastmaster.goal: Roar is BKB-piercing lockdown, summons provide vision/push, Inner Beast attack speed aura.
Beastmaster.requires: Roar on priority target, Hawk vision, Boar slow for ganks, push with summons.
Beastmaster.fights: Roar enemy carry through BKB, summons in fights for DPS/scouting, Wild Axes for stacks.
Beastmaster.dont: Roar supports, lose summons to AoE, skip Hawk scouting.
Beastmaster.timings: Helm of the Overlord 16-18min for dominated creep, Aghs Shard. Blink or Drums first.
Beastmaster.gameStage: Early: offlane push with summons, Hawk vision. Mid: Roar pickoffs, push towers. Late: BKB-piercing Roar wins fights.

Bloodseeker.goal: Snowball with kills, sustain with Bloodrage, punish movement with Rupture.
Bloodseeker.requires: Early kills to snowball, Thirst vision to find low-HP heroes, lane dominance.
Bloodseeker.fights: Rupture mobile heroes, Bloodrage yourself for damage, Blood Rite for AoE silence.
Bloodseeker.dont: Chase too deep with Thirst, Rupture immobile heroes, fight without Bloodrage active.
Bloodseeker.timings: Maelstrom/Radiance 14-16min for farm acceleration. BKB timing critical.
Bloodseeker.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Bloodrage sustain. Mid: gank with Thirst vision, Rupture kills. Late: Rupture key targets, provide Thirst vision for team.

Bounty Hunter.goal: Track for bonus gold, Jinada crit for burst, Shadow Walk for invis roaming.
Bounty Hunter.requires: Track uptime in fights (gold advantage), Jinada timing, roam efficiency.
Bounty Hunter.fights: Track all enemies in fights (bonus gold for team), Jinada burst, Shuriken Toss to finish.
Bounty Hunter.dont: Forget to Track, fight without Shadow Walk escape plan, skip utility items.
Bounty Hunter.timings: Spirit Vessel 12-14min or Solar Crest for utility. Track gold wins games economically.
Bounty Hunter.gameStage: Early: roam with invis, Track kills for gold. Mid: Track in every fight, utility items. Late: Track gold advantage, Aghs Shuriken bounce.

Brewmaster.goal: Primal Split into 3 elementals with stun/cyclone/dispel, Drunken Brawler crit/evasion.
Brewmaster.requires: Primal Split micro (Cyclone key target, stun others), Blink initiation.
Brewmaster.fights: Blink+Primal Split, Cyclone their carry, stun with Earth, Dispel with Storm.
Brewmaster.dont: Skip Primal Split micro (just watch), let elementals die fast, miss Blink timing.
Brewmaster.timings: Blink 12-14min, Aghs Shard. Primal Split fights every cooldown.
Brewmaster.gameStage: Early: offlane with Brawler, Thunder Clap slow. Mid: Blink Primal Split teamfights. Late: Primal Split utility, Cyclone key targets.

Bristleback.goal: Tank damage from behind with Bristleback passive, Quill Spray stacks, Viscous Nasal Goo armor reduce.
Bristleback.requires: Turn your back to damage, Quill stacks, Goo stacking, chase with Warpath stacks.
Bristleback.fights: Run at enemies with back turned, Quill Spray stacks, Goo for armor reduce, Warpath for speed/damage.
Bristleback.dont: Face enemies (take full damage), fight without Quill stacks, get kited without items.
Bristleback.timings: Vanguard 8-10min, Sange & Yasha 16-18min. Bristleback needs to snowball early.
Bristleback.gameStage: Early: tank lane with Bristleback passive, harass with Goo+Quills. Mid: run at people with Warpath. Late: needs items to not fall off.

Broodmother.goal: Lane dominator with spiders, web movement/invis, push lanes relentlessly.
Broodmother.requires: Spider micro (don't feed them), web placement, lane dominance, avoid AoE heroes.
Broodmother.fights: Push lanes with spiders, Insatiable Hunger for sustain/damage, webs for escape.
Broodmother.dont: Send spiders into AoE, pick Brood into AoE counters, leave webs without escape plan.
Broodmother.timings: Orchid 12-14min for kills, or Diffusal. Push timing is before enemy has AoE.
Broodmother.gameStage: Early: dominate lane, push tower with spiders. Mid: take map control with webs. Late: split push, create space.

Centaur Warrunner.goal: Stampede global haste, Hoof Stomp stun, Double Edge nuke, Retaliate returns damage.
Centaur Warrunner.requires: Blink+Stomp initiation, Double Edge trade, Stampede timing for team.
Centaur Warrunner.fights: Blink+Stomp, Double Edge for burst, Stampede for team initiation or escape.
Centaur Warrunner.dont: Double Edge when low HP, Stomp miss, Stampede without team ready.
Centaur Warrunner.timings: Blink 12-14min, Pipe/Crimson for team utility. Stampede fights win games.
Centaur Warrunner.gameStage: Early: offlane tank, Retaliate punishes attackers. Mid: Blink Stomp initiation. Late: Stampede global mobility, frontline tank.

Chaos Knight.goal: Phantasm illusions with full damage, Reality Rift pulls and reduces armor, Chaos Bolt stun.
Chaos Knight.requires: Phantasm timing (illusions are your DPS), Reality Rift to group on target, luck on Chaos Bolt.
Chaos Knight.fights: Phantasm then Reality Rift target into illusions, Chaos Bolt stun, overwhelm single target.
Chaos Knight.dont: Phantasm illusions die to AoE, fight without Phantasm, Reality Rift without illusions.
Chaos Knight.timings: Armlet 10-12min, Heart/Manta 22-25min. Phantasm fights are your timing.
Chaos Knight.gameStage: Early: Chaos Bolt kills in lane, farm. Mid: Phantasm burst kills, push towers. Late: illusion army overwhelms.

Chen.goal: Dominate jungle creeps for push/utility, global heal with Hand of God, send allies home with Holy Persuasion.
Chen.requires: Creep micro (use abilities), push timing, Hand of God global heal timing.
Chen.fights: Push with dominated creeps, Hand of God to save team globally, send low allies home.
Chen.dont: Lose creeps to AoE, skip pushing towers, Hand of God too late, bad creep selection.
Chen.timings: Mekansm 10-12min, push with creep army. Helm of the Overlord for ancient creeps.
Chen.gameStage: Early: dominate creeps, push tower with army. Mid: deathball push with team. Late: falls off, Hand of God saves.

Clinkz.goal: Invisible roaming ganker, Burning Barrage for burst, Death Pact for HP boost, Skeleton Walk for invis.
Clinkz.requires: Orchid/Gleipnir for lockdown, target selection (kill supports), map control with invis.
Clinkz.fights: Skeleton Walk to position, burst from invis, Burning Barrage for damage, Strafe for attack speed.
Clinkz.dont: Fight into detection without BKB, skip Orchid (no lockdown), team fight head-on.
Clinkz.timings: Orchid 14-16min or Gleipnir for AoE. Desolator for burst. BKB 22-24min.
Clinkz.gameStage: Early: harass with Searing Arrows, kill potential at 6. Mid: roam with invis, burst pickoffs. Late: split push, pick-off machine.

Clockwerk.goal: Hookshot initiation, trap enemies in Power Cogs, Battery Assault in close range.
Clockwerk.requires: Hookshot accuracy, Cog trapping (1v1 or cutting off), Battery Assault damage in Cogs.
Clockwerk.fights: Hookshot into enemy, Cogs to trap, Battery Assault to interrupt channels and damage.
Clockwerk.dont: Hookshot without team, Cogs trap allies, miss Hookshot, Battery Assault out of range.
Clockwerk.timings: Blade Mail 12-14min, Force Staff to push out of Cogs. Aghs Shard for Overclocking.
Clockwerk.gameStage: Early: offlane with Battery Assault kills, Rocket Flare to scout. Mid: Hookshot pickoffs. Late: Hookshot initiation, Blade Mail in Cogs.

Crystal Maiden.goal: Provide global mana regen with Arcane Aura, lockdown with Frostbite, teamfight with Freezing Field.
Crystal Maiden.requires: Careful positioning (very slow, fragile), early jungle stacking, Frostbite catches.
Crystal Maiden.fights: Stay back, Frostbite key targets, channel Freezing Field from fog or with BKB/Glimmer.
Crystal Maiden.dont: Walk forward in fights (you die instantly), skip wards, use Freezing Field without protection.
Crystal Maiden.timings: Glimmer Cape 15-18min for Freezing Field safety. BKB if snowballing.
Crystal Maiden.gameStage: Early: roam for Frostbite kills, pull and stack camps. Mid: ward aggressively, smoke ganks. Late: stay alive in fights, Aura value scales.

Dark Seer.goal: Vacuum+Wall combo, Ion Shell for lane/farm, Surge for speed boost.
Dark Seer.requires: Vacuum+Wall timing, Ion Shell harass, Surge right target.
Dark Seer.fights: Vacuum+Wall on grouped enemies (Wall copies), Ion Shell frontliners, Surge allies.
Dark Seer.dont: Vacuum one hero, Wall without Vacuum, Ion Shell wrong target, fight without Vacuum.
Dark Seer.timings: Blink 14-16min for Vacuum positioning. Mekansm/Pipe for team utility.
Dark Seer.gameStage: Early: Ion Shell lane dominance, cut waves. Mid: Vacuum+Wall teamfights. Late: combo with team AoE, Surge saves.

Dark Willow.goal: Bramble Maze for root, Shadow Realm for untargetable nuke, Terrorize for AoE fear, Bedlam for single target.
Dark Willow.requires: Bramble placement, Shadow Realm timing, Terrorize from hidden position.
Dark Willow.fights: Bramble Maze area denial, Shadow Realm burst, Terrorize fear into Bedlam DPS.
Dark Willow.dont: Terrorize miss, Shadow Realm too early, Bramble in wrong spot.
Dark Willow.timings: Eul's 12-14min for setup, Gleipnir for root. Blink for Terrorize positioning.
Dark Willow.gameStage: Early: roam with Bramble+Shadow Realm burst. Mid: Terrorize teamfights. Late: Terrorize+Bedlam combo, Shadow Realm burst.

Dawnbreaker.goal: Solar Guardian global TP+heal, Starbreaker AoE stun, Celestial Hammer slow, Luminosity heal on hits.
Dawnbreaker.requires: Solar Guardian timing (global save/join fights), Starbreaker stun, Luminosity proc management.
Dawnbreaker.fights: Solar Guardian to join fights globally, Starbreaker for AoE stun, Luminosity heals team with hits.
Dawnbreaker.dont: Solar Guardian too late, Starbreaker miss, fight without Luminosity procs.
Dawnbreaker.timings: Phase + Desolator or Echo Sabre 14-16min, BKB for Starbreaker.
Dawnbreaker.gameStage: Early: offlane with Starbreaker damage, Hammer harass. Mid: Solar Guardian ganks globally. Late: frontline with Starbreaker, global presence.

Dazzle.goal: Shallow Grave prevents death, Shadow Wave heal+damage, Bad Juju armor reduction, Poison Touch slow.
Dazzle.requires: Grave timing (before ally dies), Shadow Wave positioning, armor reduction stacking.
Dazzle.fights: Grave carry when focused, Shadow Wave for AoE heal+damage, Bad Juju reduces armor over time.
Dazzle.dont: Late Grave (ally already dead), Shadow Wave without nearby units for bounce, waste Grave on yourself.
Dazzle.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min for saves. Solar Crest synergy with armor reduction.
Dazzle.gameStage: Early: lane harass with Poison Touch, sustain with Shadow Wave. Mid: Grave saves in fights. Late: Grave is game-changing, armor reduction scales.

Death Prophet.goal: Exorcism spirits melt towers and heroes, Spirit Siphon sustain, Silence for area denial.
Death Prophet.requires: Exorcism uptime in fights, Spirit Siphon targets, push timing with Exorcism.
Death Prophet.fights: Pop Exorcism, run at enemies, Spirit Siphon for sustain, Silence casters.
Death Prophet.dont: Exorcism without a target (tower or fight), Spirit Siphon max range, fight when Exorcism on CD.
Death Prophet.timings: Eul's 12-14min for setup/survival. Push towers immediately when Exorcism is up.
Death Prophet.gameStage: Early: mid or offlane, Siphon sustain. Mid: Exorcism tower pushes, fight around ult CD. Late: Exorcism melts buildings and heroes.

Disruptor.goal: Glimpse sends enemies back, Static Storm silences+damage in area, Kinetic Field traps.
Disruptor.requires: Glimpse timing (send TP'd heroes back), Static Storm+Kinetic Field combo, Thunder Strike vision.
Disruptor.fights: Kinetic Field + Static Storm combo to trap and silence, Glimpse overextended enemies.
Disruptor.dont: Static Storm without Kinetic Field, Glimpse too late, Kinetic Field on wrong spot.
Disruptor.timings: Aghs 24-26min for mute on Static Storm. Glimmer/Force for survival.
Disruptor.gameStage: Early: Thunder Strike harass, Glimpse overextended enemies. Mid: Kinetic+Storm combo. Late: Aghs Static Storm mutes items, game-winning.

Doom.goal: Doom silences all abilities+items on one hero, Devour for creep abilities, Scorched Earth sustain.
Doom.requires: Doom target priority (shut down key hero), Devour good creep ability, Scorched Earth uptime.
Doom.fights: Doom their most important hero, Devour for utility abilities, Scorched Earth for chase/sustain.
Doom.dont: Doom supports over carry/mid, skip Devour ability, fight without Scorched Earth.
Doom.timings: Blink 14-16min for Doom initiation. BKB to prevent interruption. Shiva's for tank.
Doom.gameStage: Early: offlane with Devour gold, Scorched Earth harass. Mid: Doom pickoffs, push. Late: Doom their carry wins fights.

Dragon Knight.goal: Dragon Form ranged splash for push, Breathe Fire damage reduction, natural tankiness with Dragon Blood.
Dragon Knight.requires: Dragon Form uptime for tower pushes, stun execution, tanky itemization.
Dragon Knight.fights: Dragon Form for splash + slow/DoT, stun priority target, frontline tank.
Dragon Knight.dont: Fight without Dragon Form, skip push timing, Dragon Tail out of range.
Dragon Knight.timings: Blink 12-14min for stun initiation. BKB 18-20min. Push towers during Dragon Form.
Dragon Knight.gameStage: Early: survive mid, Dragon Blood sustain. Mid: Dragon Form tower pushes. Late: tanky frontliner, Dragon Form splash damage.

Drow Ranger.goal: Win with Marksmanship armor ignoring attacks, dominate from range, push towers fast with aura.
Drow Ranger.requires: Maintain distance for Marksmanship (disabled when enemies close), team protection, high ground.
Drow Ranger.fights: Position far back, Gust to push divers away, Multishot for AoE. Marksmanship procs win sustained fights.
Drow Ranger.dont: Let gap-closers reach you, fight in tight spaces, skip Hurricane Pike.
Drow Ranger.timings: Dragon Lance 10-12min, Pike 16-18min. Aghs timing for Multishot power spike.
Drow Ranger.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, harass with Frost Arrows. Mid: take towers with team, stay grouped. Late: siege high ground with range advantage, Gust key initiators.

Earth Spirit.goal: Roll for initiation, Magnetize DoT spreads, Boulder Smash stun, Geomagnetic Grip silence.
Earth Spirit.requires: Stone remnant management, Roll accuracy, Magnetize spreading, combo execution.
Earth Spirit.fights: Roll initiate, Smash stun, Grip silence, Magnetize and refresh with stones.
Earth Spirit.dont: Run out of stones, Roll into 5, Magnetize without stones to refresh.
Earth Spirit.timings: Spirit Vessel 12-14min, BKB 18-20min. Early roaming is the power spike.
Earth Spirit.gameStage: Early: roam with Roll+Smash+Grip combos. Mid: Magnetize teamfights, Vessel. Late: utility and initiation, Magnetize DoT.

Earthshaker.goal: Devastating teamfight with Echo Slam, block paths with Fissure, burst with Enchant Totem.
Earthshaker.requires: Blink Dagger for initiation, Fissure accuracy, patience for multi-hero Echo Slams.
Earthshaker.fights: Blink+Echo into clustered enemies, Fissure for stun chain, Totem for burst damage.
Earthshaker.dont: Echo Slam on 1-2 heroes, Fissure block allies, initiate without Blink.
Earthshaker.timings: Blink 14-18min (pos 4) or 10-12min (mid). Echo Slam fights won with 3+ targets.
Earthshaker.gameStage: Early: roam with Fissure stuns, secure runes. Mid: Blink initiation timing. Late: wait for cluster, Echo Slam wins fights.

Elder Titan.goal: Astral Spirit for damage+move speed, Echo Stomp sleep, Earth Splitter for %HP damage, Natural Order aura removes armor/magic resist.
Elder Titan.requires: Echo Stomp setup, Astral Spirit management, Earth Splitter timing.
Elder Titan.fights: Astral Spirit+Echo Stomp sleep, Earth Splitter on sleeping enemies, Natural Order aura in fights.
Elder Titan.dont: Echo Stomp breaks immediately, Earth Splitter miss, Astral Spirit without return buff.
Elder Titan.timings: Blink 16-18min for Stomp setup, Solar Crest for utility.
Elder Titan.gameStage: Early: Astral Spirit harass, Echo Stomp ganks. Mid: Stomp+Splitter combo. Late: Natural Order armor/resist removal, Splitter %HP damage.

Ember Spirit.goal: Remnant for global mobility+escape, Sleight of Fist for safe AoE, Flame Guard shield, Searing Chains root.
Ember Spirit.requires: Remnant management (escape saved), Sleight+Chain combo, Flame Guard timing.
Ember Spirit.fights: Sleight of Fist for safe damage, Searing Chains to root, Remnant in/out, Flame Guard for absorption.
Ember Spirit.dont: Use all Remnants offensively (no escape), Chains miss, Flame Guard broken by magic burst.
Ember Spirit.timings: Maelstrom 14-16min for Sleight damage, or Radiance. BKB when needed.
Ember Spirit.gameStage: Early: Flame Guard harass, Chains kills. Mid: Remnant ganks, Sleight+items damage. Late: AoE damage with Sleight, global mobility.

Enchantress.goal: Enchant creeps for push/utility, Impetus pure damage scales with distance, Untouchable slows attackers.
Enchantress.requires: Enchant strong creeps (Centaur stun, Satyr purge), Impetus range management, kite with Untouchable.
Enchantress.fights: Impetus from max range, Enchant enemy summons, Untouchable makes you hard to right-click.
Enchantress.dont: Get burst by magic (Untouchable only helps vs attacks), fight close range, skip Holy Locket.
Enchantress.timings: Holy Locket 12-14min, Dragon Lance for Impetus range. Aghs for Impetus damage.
Enchantress.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Enchant creeps, heal with Nature's Attendants. Mid: push with creeps, Impetus harass. Late: pure damage Impetus scaling.

Enigma.goal: Black Hole is the most powerful teamfight ult, Eidolons push and farm, Midnight Pulse %HP damage.
Enigma.requires: Blink for Black Hole, don't get interrupted, Eidolon micro for farm.
Enigma.fights: Blink+Midnight Pulse+Black Hole combo on 2+ heroes. Eidolons for extra damage.
Enigma.dont: Black Hole one hero, get stunned during channel, lose Eidolons to AoE.
Enigma.timings: Blink 12-14min (jungle farm), BKB 20-22min for uninterrupted Black Hole. Refresher for double Hole.
Enigma.gameStage: Early: jungle with Eidolons, push lanes. Mid: Blink Black Hole, take objectives. Late: BKB Black Hole, Refresher for insurance.

Faceless Void.goal: Chronosphere traps enemies for team follow-up, Time Walk undoes damage, bash with Time Lock.
Faceless Void.requires: Chrono placement (don't trap allies), Time Walk timing, farm speed.
Faceless Void.fights: Chrono 2-3 enemies without allies, Time Walk to dodge burst, bash targets in Chrono.
Faceless Void.dont: Chrono allies, Chrono one hero, Time Walk before taking damage (too early), fight without Chrono.
Faceless Void.timings: Maelstrom 13-15min, BKB if needed. Chrono fights every 2min are your timing.
Faceless Void.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Time Walk for survival. Mid: Chrono teamfights with team follow-up. Late: 5-man Chrono wins games.

Grimstroke.goal: Soulbind links two enemies (spells hit both), Stroke of Fate for damage, Phantom's Embrace silence, Ink Swell stun.
Grimstroke.requires: Soulbind target selection (link carry+support = double stun), Ink Swell timing.
Grimstroke.fights: Soulbind two enemies then cast single-target spells on both, Ink Swell ally for AoE stun, Phantom silence.
Grimstroke.dont: Soulbind isolated hero, Ink Swell without follow-up, Phantom on wrong target.
Grimstroke.timings: Aether Lens 14-16min for range, Aghs for Ink Swell on Soulbound targets.
Grimstroke.gameStage: Early: Stroke harass, Phantom silence kills. Mid: Soulbind combos with ally spells. Late: Soulbind doubles all single-target abilities.

Gyrocopter.goal: AoE teamfight with Flak Cannon+Call Down, Homing Missile stun, Rocket Barrage early damage.
Gyrocopter.requires: Flak Cannon item scaling, Call Down placement, Rocket Barrage close range.
Gyrocopter.fights: Flak Cannon hits everyone in range, Call Down for AoE slow, Homing Missile to stun.
Gyrocopter.dont: Rocket Barrage from far, Call Down on wrong spot, Flak Cannon without damage items.
Gyrocopter.timings: Maelstrom 12-14min, BKB 18-20min. Flak Cannon with items is the scaling mechanic.
Gyrocopter.gameStage: Early: Rocket Barrage kill potential, Homing Missile ganks. Mid: Flak Cannon fights. Late: AoE right-click carry with Flak.

Hoodwink.goal: Sharpshooter long range nuke+break, Acorn Shot bounces, Bushwhack tree stun, Scurry for evasion near trees.
Hoodwink.requires: Bushwhack near trees for stun, Sharpshooter aim, Acorn Shot for harassment.
Hoodwink.fights: Bushwhack stun near trees, Acorn Shot for damage, Sharpshooter to finish/break passives.
Hoodwink.dont: Sharpshooter miss, Bushwhack without trees, fight in open away from trees.
Hoodwink.timings: Gleipnir 16-18min for Bushwhack setup, or Maelstrom. Aghs for Decoy.
Hoodwink.gameStage: Early: Acorn harass, Bushwhack kills. Mid: Sharpshooter snipes, Bushwhack ganks. Late: break passives with Sharpshooter, Acorn AoE.

Huskar.goal: Fight at low HP — Berserker's Blood gives attack speed and magic resist. Life Break initiates.
Huskar.requires: Know HP threshold, Burning Spear stacking, Armlet toggling, BKB timing.
Huskar.fights: Life Break the target you want to kill, Burning Spear stacks, tank with Berserker's Blood.
Huskar.dont: Get bursted through Berserker's Blood (pure/physical), Life Break into 5, fight into AA ult.
Huskar.timings: Armlet 8-10min, BKB 16-18min. Huskar's window is 10-25min — end before late game.
Huskar.gameStage: Early: dominate lane, Burning Spear harass. Mid: snowball with Armlet, end game early. Late: falls off hard, end before 30min.

Invoker.goal: 10 spells with Quas/Wex/Exort combos, adapts to any situation, scales all game.
Invoker.requires: Spell combo execution, Invoke timing, know when to use which spell.
Invoker.fights: Tornado+EMP or Tornado+Meteor+Blast combo, Cold Snap for lockdown, Forge Spirits for DPS.
Invoker.dont: Invoke wrong spell, miss Tornado/Sun Strike, use Deafening Blast without setup.
Invoker.timings: Hand of Midas 8-10min (Exort), Blink 16-18min. Level 25 talent is huge power spike.
Invoker.gameStage: Early: Sun Strike snipes (Exort) or Cold Snap ganks (Quas/Wex). Mid: combo teamfights. Late: all 10 spells, adapts to anything.

Io.goal: Tether to ally for shared regen and relocate, Overcharge for attack speed, Spirits for damage.
Io.requires: Tether target (stay with carry), Relocate timing (save or gank), Overcharge management.
Io.fights: Tether carry, Overcharge for attack speed, Relocate for global ganks/saves.
Io.dont: Break Tether, Relocate into 5 enemies, Overcharge without Tether partner.
Io.timings: Holy Locket for heal amp, Mekansm for heal share. Io+carry combo is the timing.
Io.gameStage: Early: lane with carry, Tether sustain. Mid: Relocate ganks across map. Late: keep carry alive with Tether+Overcharge.

Jakiro.goal: Dual Breath for slow/damage, Ice Path stun, Liquid Fire tower damage, Macropyre area denial.
Jakiro.requires: Ice Path accuracy, Liquid Fire on towers constantly, Macropyre placement.
Jakiro.fights: Ice Path stun followed by Dual Breath and Macropyre, Liquid Fire attack speed slow.
Jakiro.dont: Ice Path miss, Macropyre on moving targets (they walk out), skip Liquid Fire tower damage.
Jakiro.timings: Eul's 14-16min for Ice Path setup. Force Staff for saves.
Jakiro.gameStage: Early: push lane with Liquid Fire, harass. Mid: Ice Path + team follow-up, push towers. Late: Macropyre zone control, Ice Path stun.

Juggernaut.goal: Reliable carry with Blade Fury magic immunity, Healing Ward sustain, Omnislash burst.
Juggernaut.requires: Farm speed, Blade Fury kill potential early, Omnislash single-target isolation.
Juggernaut.fights: Blade Fury to dodge spells, Healing Ward behind team, Omnislash isolated targets.
Juggernaut.dont: Omnislash into creep waves, pop Blade Fury when you should be right-clicking, forget Healing Ward.
Juggernaut.timings: Battlefury 14-15min or Maelstrom 11-12min. Aghs timing strong at 25min.
Juggernaut.gameStage: Early: Blade Fury + support kills in lane, push tower. Mid: farm with cleave, take objectives. Late: Omnislash pick-offs, right-click carry with items.

Keeper of the Light.goal: Illuminate for wave clear, Chakra Magic for mana, Will-O-Wisp to blind, Blinding Light knockback.
Keeper of the Light.requires: Illuminate charging, Chakra Magic on right ally, Will-O-Wisp placement.
Keeper of the Light.fights: Will-O-Wisp in teamfight (enemies can't act when facing), Chakra key ally, Illuminate for damage.
Keeper of the Light.dont: Illuminate without charging, Chakra yourself over carry, Will-O-Wisp destroyed instantly.
Keeper of the Light.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min, Aghs for Illuminate heal. Solar Crest for utility.
Keeper of the Light.gameStage: Early: Illuminate wave push, Chakra carry for sustain. Mid: Will-O-Wisp fights, push with Illuminate. Late: Chakra CD reduction for carry, Will-O-Wisp control.

Kez.goal: Shodo Slash for burst+mobility, Falcon Rush for gap close, Talon Toss for throw, Katana Blitz for rapid strikes.
Kez.requires: Combo execution, Shodo Slash positioning, Falcon Rush timing.
Kez.fights: Falcon Rush gap close, Shodo Slash burst, Talon Toss to reposition enemies, Katana Blitz for DPS.
Kez.dont: Shodo Slash without a target, fight without combo available, Falcon Rush into 5.
Kez.gameStage: Early: farm safe/mid, combo kills. Mid: burst pickoffs with full combo. Late: mobile burst carry.

Kunkka.goal: Cleave with Tidebringer, X Marks setup into Torrent+Ghost Ship combo, Rum buff for team.
Kunkka.requires: X Marks combo execution, Tidebringer last-hit harass, Ghost Ship accuracy.
Kunkka.fights: X+Torrent+Ship combo, Rum buff allies, Tidebringer cleave in fights.
Kunkka.dont: Miss X combo, waste Tidebringer on creeps during fights, Ship without setup.
Kunkka.timings: Armlet 10-12min or Radiance 16-18min. Daedalus for Tidebringer one-shots.
Kunkka.gameStage: Early: Tidebringer harass in lane. Mid: X combo pickoffs, push with team. Late: Tidebringer cleave carries fights, Rum saves team.

Largo.goal: Long range artillery hero, Bombard for siege, Gargantuan for AoE stun, Vault for mobility.
Largo.requires: Bombard aim, Gargantuan timing, positioning at max range.
Largo.fights: Bombard from distance, Gargantuan for teamfight stun, stay at max range.
Largo.dont: Fight close range, Gargantuan miss, overextend without Vault escape.
Largo.timings: Maelstrom for farm, Pike for positioning. Plays like a siege hero.
Largo.gameStage: Early: lane with long range, harass. Mid: siege towers with range, Gargantuan fights. Late: artillery damage from distance.

Legion Commander.goal: Duel locks two heroes in 1v1 (winner gets permanent damage), Overwhelming Odds nuke, Press the Attack dispel+heal.
Legion Commander.requires: Duel target (must win), Blink+Duel execution, Press the Attack to save or buff.
Legion Commander.fights: Blink+Duel weak target for guaranteed win, Press the Attack to dispel ally, Overwhelming Odds for damage.
Legion Commander.dont: Duel tanky heroes you can't kill, Duel without team, feed Duel damage to enemy.
Legion Commander.timings: Blink 12-14min, Blade Mail 10-12min for Duel safety, BKB 20-22min.
Legion Commander.gameStage: Early: dominate offlane with Overwhelming Odds, jungle. Mid: Blink+Duel pickoffs, stack damage. Late: permanent damage stacking carry.

Leshrac.goal: Pulse Nova AoE magic damage aura, Split Earth stun, Lightning Storm spam, tower demolisher.
Leshrac.requires: Mana sustain for Pulse Nova, Split Earth accuracy, survive being in the middle of fights.
Leshrac.fights: Pulse Nova + run at enemies, Split Earth stun, Lightning Storm spam for DPS.
Leshrac.dont: Pulse Nova without mana, Split Earth miss, stay at range (you need to be close).
Leshrac.timings: Bloodstone 16-18min for Pulse Nova sustain. BKB 20-22min. Travels for push.
Leshrac.gameStage: Early: push lane with Lightning, stun for kills. Mid: Pulse Nova team fights, push towers fast. Late: Bloodstone sustain, AoE damage machine.

Lich.goal: Chain Frost bounces devastate grouped enemies, Frost Blast slow, Frost Shield damage reduction.
Lich.requires: Chain Frost targeting (bounces need grouped enemies), Frost Shield on right ally, lane dominance.
Lich.fights: Frost Shield your frontliner, Chain Frost into grouped enemies, Blast to slow.
Lich.dont: Chain Frost into single target, Frost Shield too late, skip Sinister Gaze.
Lich.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min for saves. Chain Frost at level 6 is huge power spike.
Lich.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with nukes, zone enemy. Mid: Chain Frost teamfights. Late: Frost Shield carry, Chain Frost grouped fights.

Lifestealer.goal: Built-in BKB with Rage, sustain with Feast lifesteal, Infest for surprise initiation.
Lifestealer.requires: Rage timing, right-click damage items, Infest target selection.
Lifestealer.fights: Rage through disables, Feast sustain in fights, Infest ally for surprise initiation.
Lifestealer.dont: Rage preemptively, get kited (no gap close), fight without Feast sustain.
Lifestealer.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Feast sustain. Mid: Rage through stuns, fight with team. Late: BKB-piercing Rage, sustained fighter.

Lina.goal: High burst magic/pure damage, Fiery Soul attack speed stacks, Laguna Blade to delete heroes.
Lina.requires: Spell combos for Fiery Soul stacks, LSA stun accuracy, mana management.
Lina.fights: Chain stun with LSA, stack Fiery Soul, Laguna Blade to finish, right-click with stacks.
Lina.dont: Miss LSA, Laguna when target has too much HP, fight without Fiery Soul stacks.
Lina.timings: Eul's 12min for LSA setup. Aghs for pure Laguna. BKB 18-20min.
Lina.gameStage: Early: dominate mid, nuke waves. Mid: Eul's combo kills, push towers. Late: burst caster or right-click hybrid with Fiery Soul.

Lion.goal: Chain disable with Earth Spike + Hex, Finger of Death burst, Mana Drain sustain.
Lion.requires: Blink for initiation, chain stun execution, Finger kill stacks for damage.
Lion.fights: Blink+Spike+Hex chain disable, Finger priority target, Mana Drain between spells.
Lion.dont: Finger tanky heroes, Hex before Spike (wrong order), position too forward.
Lion.timings: Blink 16-18min. Aether Lens for catch range. Aghs Shard for AoE Spike.
Lion.gameStage: Early: roam with double disable, set up kills. Mid: Blink catches, Finger kills. Late: disable chain, save Finger for key target.

Lone Druid.goal: Spirit Bear is a second hero with items, True Form for tankiness, Savage Roar fear.
Lone Druid.requires: Bear micro (keep Bear alive), Bear item build, True Form toggling.
Lone Druid.fights: Bear attacks with items, True Form for tank, Savage Roar to fear enemies away.
Lone Druid.dont: Let Bear die (huge cooldown), fight without Bear nearby, skip Bear items.
Lone Druid.timings: Mask of Madness on Bear 8-10min, Desolator 14-16min. Push towers with Bear.
Lone Druid.gameStage: Early: Bear harass in lane, push tower. Mid: push with Bear items. Late: Bear is a full carry, True Form sustain.

Luna.goal: Lucent Beam bouncing ult, Moon Glaives for AoE farm/damage, Lunar Blessing aura.
Luna.requires: Farm speed, Eclipse single target or AoE burst, Moon Glaive for push.
Luna.fights: Eclipse isolated or small groups, Glaives bounce damage, Lucent Beam stun.
Luna.dont: Eclipse in creep waves, fight before items, skip BKB.
Luna.timings: Dragon Lance 10-12min, BKB+Manta 22-25min. Eclipse at 6 is strong kill potential.
Luna.gameStage: Early: farm fast with Glaives, Luna Blessing for lane. Mid: push with Glaives, Eclipse fights. Late: right-click carry with Glaive bounces.

Lycan.goal: Push towers with summons, Shapeshift for max speed and crit, howl buff for team.
Lycan.requires: Push timing with Shapeshift, summon management, Howl before fights.
Lycan.fights: Shapeshift for unslowable chase, summons for DPS, Howl for team damage.
Lycan.dont: Fight without Shapeshift, lose wolves to AoE, ignore push timing, go too late.
Lycan.timings: Helm of the Overlord 14-16min, push during Shapeshift. Assault Cuirass for team push.
Lycan.gameStage: Early: jungle with wolves, push lanes. Mid: Shapeshift tower pushes, end game fast. Late: falls off, needs to end early.

Magnus.goal: Reverse Polarity is game-winning AoE stun+pull, Empower for cleave buff, Skewer repositions.
Magnus.requires: Blink+RP on multiple heroes, Empower your carry, Skewer accuracy.
Magnus.fights: Blink+RP 3+ heroes, Empower carry for cleave, Skewer into team after RP.
Magnus.dont: RP one hero, Empower wrong hero, Skewer into enemies without team.
Magnus.timings: Blink 14-16min, BKB for RP, Refresher for double RP. Empower your carry at all stages.
Magnus.gameStage: Early: Empower carry, farm with Shockwave. Mid: Blink RP teamfights. Late: Refresher double RP, Empower carry.

Marci.goal: Dispose throw+stun, Rebound for mobility+stun, Sidekick for ally buff+lifesteal, Unleash for burst attack speed.
Marci.requires: Dispose targeting, Rebound positioning, Unleash timing, Sidekick right ally.
Marci.fights: Dispose throw enemy into allies, Rebound for gap close+stun, Unleash for burst DPS, Sidekick carry.
Marci.dont: Dispose wrong direction, Rebound without follow-up, Unleash without a target.
Marci.timings: BKB 16-18min for Unleash, Basher/Abyssal for lockdown. Desolator for burst.
Marci.gameStage: Early: roam with Dispose+Rebound combo. Mid: Unleash fights, snowball. Late: BKB Unleash burst, Dispose for pickoffs.

Mars.goal: Arena of Blood traps enemies, God's Rebuke AoE crit, Spear of Mars stun against wall/tree, Bulwark front block.
Mars.requires: Spear+wall stun, Arena placement, God's Rebuke crit, Bulwark direction.
Mars.fights: Spear into Arena wall stun, Arena traps enemies, God's Rebuke for AoE crit damage, Bulwark to tank.
Mars.dont: Spear without wall behind target, Arena in open (enemies walk through sides), Bulwark wrong direction.
Mars.timings: Blink 12-14min for Spear+Arena combo, BKB 18-20min. Phase for God's Rebuke damage.
Mars.gameStage: Early: offlane with God's Rebuke harass, Spear stuns. Mid: Blink Arena fights. Late: Arena teamfight control, Spear pickoffs.

Medusa.goal: Hardest carry to kill — Mana Shield absorbs damage, Stone Gaze petrifies, Split Shot for AoE.
Medusa.requires: Farm for items (very slow start), Mana Shield mana management, Stone Gaze timing.
Medusa.fights: Stand in front with Mana Shield, Split Shot all enemies, Stone Gaze when enemies face you.
Medusa.dont: Fight before items, Stone Gaze when enemies look away, run out of mana (Mana Shield drops).
Medusa.timings: Manta 22-25min, Skadi 28-30min. Medusa needs 3+ items to fight.
Medusa.gameStage: Early: farm, farm, farm. Mid: farm ancients+lanes with Split Shot. Late: unkillable with items, Stone Gaze wins fights.

Meepo.goal: Multiple clones share XP, Poof for burst AoE/mobility, Earthbind root, Ransack lifesteal.
Meepo.requires: Clone micro (all die if one dies), Poof combos, net accuracy, level advantage.
Meepo.fights: Poof all Meepos together for burst, Earthbind roots, Ransack sustain, overwhelm with numbers.
Meepo.dont: Lose one Meepo (all die), fight into AoE, skip Blink, get outleveled.
Meepo.timings: Blink 10-12min (fast with clone XP), Aghs/Scythe for control. Level advantage IS the timing.
Meepo.gameStage: Early: powerfarm with clones, hit 10+ by 10min. Mid: Poof ganks, push towers. Late: falls off vs AoE, end before 30min.

Mirana.goal: Flexible hero — roam with Sacred Arrow stuns, Leap for mobility, Starfall burst.
Mirana.requires: Arrow accuracy (5s stun at max range), team follow-up on arrows, flex pick advantage.
Mirana.fights: Arrow priority targets from fog, Leap in/out, Starfall for burst. Moonlight Shadow for team invis ganks.
Mirana.dont: Throw arrows without setup, Leap aggressively without escape plan, skip utility items.
Mirana.timings: First core item 12-14min varies by role. Arrow+kill combos are the timing.
Mirana.gameStage: Early: roam and arrow, secure kills with supports. Mid: push with team, arrow from trees. Late: utility/damage hybrid, Moonlight Shadow for positioning.

Monkey King.goal: Wukong's Command creates soldier ring, Jingu Mastery stacks for lifesteal/damage, Tree Dance mobility, Boundless Strike crit.
Monkey King.requires: Jingu Mastery 4-hit proc, Wukong's Command placement, Tree Dance scouting.
Monkey King.fights: Jingu proc then Wukong's Command, Boundless Strike crit, Tree Dance for positioning.
Monkey King.dont: Wukong's Command miss, fight without Jingu stacks, Tree Dance predictably.
Monkey King.timings: Echo Sabre 12-14min for Jingu procs, Desolator/BKB. Jingu proc is your power spike.
Monkey King.gameStage: Early: Tree Dance ganks, Jingu burst in lane. Mid: Wukong fights, Boundless Strike. Late: Wukong Command teamfighter.

Morphling.goal: Shift between AGI (damage) and STR (survival), burst with Adaptive Strike, replicate enemy heroes.
Morphling.requires: Farm for stat items, Morph management (don't get bursted while AGI), Linken's/Manta timing.
Morphling.fights: Morph STR to survive burst, shift AGI to kill, Adaptive Strike for stun/nuke, Replicate for outplay.
Morphling.dont: Full AGI morph against burst damage, fight without Morph shift available, replicate wrong hero.
Morphling.timings: Ethereal Blade 18-20min for shotgun combo. Manta/Linken's for survivability.
Morphling.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Waveform for last hits. Mid: Ethereal shotgun kills, farm aggressively. Late: stat-heavy carry, Replicate outplays.

Muerta.goal: Dead Shot ricochet fear, The Calling ghosts slow+silence, Pierce the Veil for magic immunity+ghost damage.
Muerta.requires: Dead Shot angles for fear, Calling placement, Veil timing for immunity.
Muerta.fights: Dead Shot fear into team, Calling zone control, Pierce the Veil for magic immunity DPS.
Muerta.dont: Dead Shot without wall angle, Calling in wrong spot, Veil when no enemies near.
Muerta.timings: Gleipnir/Maelstrom 14-16min, BKB/Aghs. Pierce the Veil at 6 is a strong spike.
Muerta.gameStage: Early: Dead Shot harass, Calling zone control. Mid: Veil fights, Dead Shot fear picks. Late: Pierce the Veil physical immunity DPS.

Naga Siren.goal: Illusion split push/farm, Song of the Siren for setup/disengage, Ensnare root, Riptide armor reduce. Illusions nerfed in 7.40.
Naga Siren.requires: Illusion micro for split push, Song timing, farm speed. Diffusal no longer works on illusions — need stat-based build.
Naga Siren.fights: Song to set up or disengage, illusions to push and scout, Ensnare key targets, Riptide armor reduce.
Naga Siren.dont: Song at wrong time (save enemies), DO NOT buy Diffusal (mana burn no longer works on illusions), illusions die to AoE.
Naga Siren.timings: Manta 18-20min, Heart/Butterfly 26-28min for illusion scaling. Song of the Siren regen nerfed too.
Naga Siren.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane. Mid: split push with illusions, Song fights. Late: stat-heavy illusion army, weaker than previous patches.

Nature's Prophet.goal: Global presence with Teleportation, Sprout to trap, Wrath of Nature for global damage/farm.
Nature's Prophet.requires: Teleport timing (don't TP into death), split push awareness, Sprout accuracy.
Nature's Prophet.fights: Teleport to fights, Sprout key targets, Treants for push, Wrath of Nature for damage.
Nature's Prophet.dont: TP into 5 heroes, AFK split push ignoring team, Sprout allies accidentally.
Nature's Prophet.timings: Orchid 14-16min for ganks, or Gleipnir for teamfight. Aghs for Wrath bounce.
Nature's Prophet.gameStage: Early: jungle+gank with TP, push lanes. Mid: global TP pressure, split push. Late: constant split push, TP to fights.

Necrophos.goal: Reaper's Scythe kills add to death timer, sustain with Death Pulse, Ghost Shroud for magic heal amp.
Necrophos.requires: Stay alive in fights (Heart/tanky), Scythe timing (% HP threshold), Ghost Shroud timing.
Necrophos.fights: Stay in the fight healing with Pulse, Ghost Shroud for burst survival, Scythe to extend death timers.
Necrophos.dont: Scythe full HP heroes, Ghost Shroud against magic damage, skip Radiance timing.
Necrophos.timings: Radiance 16-18min for sustain fights. Holy Locket or Heart for tankiness.
Necrophos.gameStage: Early: win lane with Death Pulse sustain. Mid: push with Radiance, extended fights favor you. Late: Scythe key heroes, death timer wins.

Night Stalker.goal: Nighttime powerhouse — bonus speed/damage at night, Void slow, Crippling Fear silence, Dark Ascension vision.
Night Stalker.requires: Play around day/night cycle, Dark Ascension at night for flying vision, gap close.
Night Stalker.fights: Void slow into Crippling Fear silence, Dark Ascension for vision+flying, run at targets at night.
Night Stalker.dont: Fight during daytime (much weaker), waste Dark Ascension, skip BKB.
Night Stalker.timings: Phase Boots + early gank items. BKB 16-18min. First night (5min) is crucial power spike.
Night Stalker.gameStage: Early: dominate first night with ganks. Mid: Dark Ascension night fights, control vision. Late: silence+slow, night vision control.

Nyx Assassin.goal: Vendetta invis burst, Spiked Carapace stun reflect, Impale stun, Mana Burn on INT heroes.
Nyx Assassin.requires: Vendetta positioning, Carapace timing (reflect key spells), Impale accuracy.
Nyx Assassin.fights: Vendetta from invis for burst, Carapace to reflect stuns, Impale for chain disable, Mana Burn casters.
Nyx Assassin.dont: Carapace too early/late, Impale miss, Vendetta without team nearby.
Nyx Assassin.timings: Aghs for Burrow (AoE Impale), Meteor Hammer combo, Aether Lens.
Nyx Assassin.gameStage: Early: roam with Vendetta ganks. Mid: Carapace reflect key spells, Impale stuns. Late: Aghs Burrow for AoE stun, scout with Vendetta.

Ogre Magi.goal: Multicast multiplies spells, Fireblast reliable stun, Ignite for slow/DoT, Bloodlust for ally buff.
Ogre Magi.requires: Bloodlust your carry, Fireblast priority targets, Ignite for chase, Multicast luck.
Ogre Magi.fights: Fireblast stun key target, Bloodlust your carry, Ignite slow fleeing enemies.
Ogre Magi.dont: Forget Bloodlust (huge buff), Fireblast wrong target, skip Ignite slow.
Ogre Magi.timings: Force Staff/Glimmer 14-16min, or Midas for levels. Aghs for Unrefined Fireblast.
Ogre Magi.gameStage: Early: zone with Ignite+Fireblast, tank with high armor/HP. Mid: Bloodlust carry, stun in fights. Late: Bloodlust value, Multicast burst.

Omniknight.goal: Guardian Angel grants physical immunity, Purification burst heal+damage, Heavenly Grace dispel+status resist.
Omniknight.requires: Guardian Angel timing, Purification accuracy (centered on ally), Heavenly Grace before stuns.
Omniknight.fights: Guardian Angel when team is focused by physical, Purification heal+damage, Grace before disable.
Omniknight.dont: Late Guardian Angel, Purification miss (point blank AoE), Grace after ally is stunned.
Omniknight.timings: Holy Locket for heal amp, Soul Ring for mana. Guardian Angel timing wins fights.
Omniknight.gameStage: Early: sustain lane with Purification, Grace for saves. Mid: Guardian Angel teamfights. Late: save allies, Guardian Angel is game-changing.

Oracle.goal: False Promise makes ally invisible and delays damage/healing, Purifying Flames heal, Fortune's End dispel.
Oracle.requires: False Promise timing (all damage/heals resolved after), Flames+Fortune combo, Fate's Edict.
Oracle.fights: False Promise carry when bursted, Purifying Flames for burst heal, Fortune's End for dispel.
Oracle.dont: False Promise too late, Flames enemy without follow-up purge, Fate's Edict on wrong target.
Oracle.timings: Glimmer Cape 14-16min, Holy Locket for heal amp during False Promise.
Oracle.gameStage: Early: strong lane with Flames+Fortune combo. Mid: False Promise saves in fights. Late: False Promise is one of the best saves in the game.

Outworld Destroyer.goal: Sanity's Eclipse based on mana/INT difference, Astral Imprisonment for save/setup, Arcane Orb pure damage.
Outworld Destroyer.requires: Mana/INT stacking, Astral timing (save or offense), Arcane Orb for right-click damage.
Outworld Destroyer.fights: Arcane Orb for sustained pure damage, Astral to save ally or set up, Sanity's Eclipse for burst.
Outworld Destroyer.dont: Sanity's Eclipse when enemy INT is high, Astral at wrong time, run out of mana.
Outworld Destroyer.timings: Witch Blade/Meteor Hammer 12-14min, BKB 18-20min. Arcane Orb scales with INT items.
Outworld Destroyer.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Arcane Orb, Astral harass. Mid: Sanity's Eclipse burst, BKB fights. Late: INT scaling carry, pure damage.

Pangolier.goal: Rolling Thunder bounces and stuns, Shield Crash damage reduction, Swashbuckle procs on-hit, Lucky Shot disarm.
Pangolier.requires: Rolling Thunder bouncing, Shield Crash timing, Swashbuckle+on-hit items.
Pangolier.fights: Rolling Thunder for AoE stuns (bounce off walls), Shield Crash for damage reduction, Swashbuckle for procs.
Pangolier.dont: Rolling Thunder in open (no walls to bounce), Shield Crash without enemies, miss Swashbuckle.
Pangolier.timings: Diffusal/Basher 14-16min for Swashbuckle procs, Blink for positioning.
Pangolier.gameStage: Early: offlane/mid with Swashbuckle+Shield Crash. Mid: Rolling Thunder teamfights. Late: Rolling Thunder stun chain, Swashbuckle on-hit scaling.

Phantom Assassin.goal: Crit burst with Coup de Grace, Blink Strike for gap close, Blur for evasion, Stifling Dagger harass.
Phantom Assassin.requires: BKB timing (MKB counters evasion), Desolator for early burst, snowball from kills.
Phantom Assassin.fights: Blink Strike onto backline, crit burst supports/carries, Blur to dodge attacks.
Phantom Assassin.dont: Fight into MKB carriers without BKB, crit relies on luck — need attack speed, skip Desolator.
Phantom Assassin.timings: Desolator 14-16min for burst, BKB 20-22min. Battlefury for farm-oriented games.
Phantom Assassin.gameStage: Early: Dagger harass in lane, last hit safely. Mid: Desolator burst pickoffs. Late: crit one-shots with Daedalus, need BKB+Satanic.

Phantom Lancer.goal: Overwhelm with illusions via Juxtapose, hard to pin down with Doppelganger. Illusions NERFED in 7.40 (no mana burn, reduced vision).
Phantom Lancer.requires: Stat items to make illusions tanky (Diffusal no longer works on illusions), farm speed, Doppelganger usage.
Phantom Lancer.fights: Send illusions in, find real PL positioning, Doppelganger to dodge/disjoint, overwhelm supports. New Illusory Armaments gives min damage floor.
Phantom Lancer.dont: Buy Diffusal Blade — mana burn no longer works on illusions since 7.40. Avoid AoE-heavy matchups, don't fight before stat items.
Phantom Lancer.timings: Heart/Skadi 22-25min for illusion tankiness. Manta Style for more illusions. Butterfly for AGI scaling. Weakened this patch.
Phantom Lancer.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Phantom Edge for evasion. Mid: split push with illusions. Late: stat-heavy illusion army, but weaker than previous patches.

Phoenix.goal: Supernova stun if egg survives, Fire Spirits attack speed slow, Icarus Dive for mobility, Sun Ray %HP.
Phoenix.requires: Supernova placement (egg must survive), Fire Spirits accuracy, Dive positioning.
Phoenix.fights: Fire Spirits slow attack speed, Sun Ray for %HP damage/heal, Supernova when focused.
Phoenix.dont: Supernova in open (egg killed), Fire Spirits miss, Dive into 5 without escape.
Phoenix.timings: Shiva's Guard for Supernova protection, Refresher for double Supernova. Vessel synergy.
Phoenix.gameStage: Early: offlane/support with Fire Spirits harass, Sun Ray sustain. Mid: Supernova teamfights. Late: Supernova+Refresher, Sun Ray %HP.

Primal Beast.goal: Pulverize BKB-piercing channel grab, Onslaught charge knockback, Trample AoE damage, Uproar stacking.
Primal Beast.requires: Onslaught angle, Pulverize timing, Trample during Onslaught, Uproar stacks.
Primal Beast.fights: Onslaught into Pulverize grab, Trample for AoE, Uproar for damage reduction stacks.
Primal Beast.dont: Onslaught miss, Pulverize without team, get kited without Onslaught.
Primal Beast.timings: BKB 14-16min for uninterrupted Pulverize, Blink for initiation.
Primal Beast.gameStage: Early: offlane with Trample damage. Mid: Onslaught+Pulverize initiation. Late: BKB-piercing Pulverize, frontline tank.

Puck.goal: Elusive mid with Phase Shift, initiate with Dream Coil, silence with Waning Rift.
Puck.requires: Phase Shift timing, Blink for initiation, Dream Coil on multiple heroes.
Puck.fights: Blink+Coil+Rift combo, Phase Shift dodges, Orb for escape/chase.
Puck.dont: Dream Coil one hero, Phase Shift too early, Orb aggressively without escape.
Puck.timings: Witch Blade/Eul's 12-14min. Blink 15-17min for Coil initiation.
Puck.gameStage: Early: win mid with Orb+Rift harass. Mid: gank with Coil, control tempo. Late: initiation and silence, elusive teamfighter.

Pudge.goal: Hook heroes out of position, Dismember to lock down, Rot for slow/damage, Flesh Heap tankiness.
Pudge.requires: Hook accuracy, roaming timing, snowball with kills for Flesh Heap stacks.
Pudge.fights: Hook priority targets, Dismember the carry/mid, Rot to slow in fights.
Pudge.dont: Miss hooks and waste time, hook through creeps, Dismember without team nearby.
Pudge.timings: Blink 15-18min for guaranteed Dismember. Aghs Shard for Rot buff.
Pudge.gameStage: Early: roam from pos 4/5 or dominate mid. Mid: smoke+hook picks, Blink initiation. Late: tank with Flesh Heap stacks, hook key targets.

Pugna.goal: Nether Ward punishes spell-heavy teams, Life Drain sustain/damage, Decrepify amplifies magic.
Pugna.requires: Nether Ward placement, Decrepify timing (friend or foe), Life Drain channel safety.
Pugna.fights: Nether Ward before fight, Decrepify+Nether Blast combo, Life Drain to sustain or finish.
Pugna.dont: Decrepify enemy physical carry (saves them from your carry), Ward in bad position, Life Drain without protection.
Pugna.timings: Aether Lens 12-14min, Aghs for heal through Life Drain. Dagon for burst build.
Pugna.gameStage: Early: push lane with Nether Blast. Mid: Nether Ward teamfights punish casters. Late: Life Drain sustain, Decrepify key targets.

Queen of Pain.goal: Blink for mobility, Scream+Sonic Wave burst, snowball with early kills.
Queen of Pain.requires: Blink aggressive+defensive use, combo execution, early kill potential.
Queen of Pain.fights: Blink in, Scream+Wave combo, Blink out. Shadow Strike to slow runners.
Queen of Pain.dont: Blink into 5 heroes, Wave on single target, fight without Blink cooldown.
Queen of Pain.timings: Orchid 14-16min for solo kills. Aghs for pure Wave damage. BKB when needed.
Queen of Pain.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Scream, Blink at 6. Mid: Orchid pickoffs, Wave teamfights. Late: burst damage, Blink mobility.

Razor.goal: Drain enemy damage with Static Link, run at people with speed, Eye of the Storm melts buildings.
Razor.requires: Get on top of link target, maintain link duration, BKB for uninterrupted link.
Razor.fights: Static Link enemy carry, run at them, Eye of the Storm for armor reduction, Plasma Field for AoE.
Razor.dont: Link supports instead of carry, break link early, fight without Eye of the Storm.
Razor.timings: BKB 16-18min for full link duration. Refresher for double Eye of the Storm.
Razor.gameStage: Early: win lane with Static Link pressure. Mid: push towers with Eye of the Storm. Late: drain carry damage, siege with team.

Riki.goal: Permanent invisibility, Smoke Screen silence+miss, Tricks of the Trade AoE backstab.
Riki.requires: Target selection (kill supports), Smoke Screen placement, Diffusal for slow+mana burn.
Riki.fights: Smoke Screen enemy carry, backstab supports, Tricks of the Trade to dodge and AoE damage.
Riki.dont: Fight into detection, Smoke Screen wrong targets, roam without Diffusal.
Riki.timings: Diffusal 14-16min for kill potential. BKB 22-24min to fight into detection.
Riki.gameStage: Early: roam and backstab, scout with invis. Mid: pickoffs with Smoke+Diffusal. Late: Tricks of the Trade teamfight, target backline.

Ringmaster.goal: Wheel of Wonder for AoE debuffs, Escape Act for ally saves, Tame the Beasts for summon control.
Ringmaster.requires: Escape Act timing, Wheel placement, team coordination.
Ringmaster.fights: Escape Act to reposition allies, Wheel for teamfight control, Dark in the Spotlight for damage.
Ringmaster.dont: Escape Act too late, Wheel on wrong area, poor Spotlight placement.
Ringmaster.timings: Glimmer/Force for saves, Aether Lens for range.
Ringmaster.gameStage: Early: lane harass, set up kills. Mid: team fight utility. Late: save allies with Escape Act, Wheel control.

Rubick.goal: Spell Steal copies enemy abilities, Telekinesis lift+throw, Fade Bolt damage reduction.
Rubick.requires: Steal the RIGHT spell (game-changing), Telekinesis positioning, Fade Bolt in fights.
Rubick.fights: Steal big ults (Ravage, Black Hole, RP), Telekinesis for setup, Fade Bolt damage reduction.
Rubick.dont: Steal bad spells, Telekinesis without follow-up, miss timing on Spell Steal.
Rubick.timings: Blink 16-18min for positioning, Aether Lens for Steal range. Aghs for instant Steal.
Rubick.gameStage: Early: Fade Bolt harass, Telekinesis kills. Mid: Spell Steal key ults. Late: stolen ult wins fights, Blink+Steal.

Sand King.goal: Initiate with Blink+Epicenter, Burrowstrike stun, Sandstorm for farming/invis.
Sand King.requires: Blink for Epicenter initiation, channel time awareness, Caustic Finale for lane/farm.
Sand King.fights: Blink+Epicenter from fog, Burrowstrike chain stun, Sandstorm to reposition.
Sand King.dont: Epicenter without Blink, get interrupted during channel, Burrowstrike into 5 without team.
Sand King.timings: Blink 12-14min. Epicenter + Blink timing is the hero's entire power spike.
Sand King.gameStage: Early: offlane or mid, farm with Sandstorm+Caustic. Mid: Blink Epicenter teamfights. Late: initiate and control, Aghs for Sandstorm damage.

Shadow Demon.goal: Disruption for save/setup+illusions, Demonic Purge slows+dispels, Soul Catcher damage amp.
Shadow Demon.requires: Disruption timing (save or offensive), Soul Catcher placement, Purge for dispel.
Shadow Demon.fights: Disruption saves allies or creates illusions of enemy carry, Soul Catcher to amp damage, Purge slows.
Shadow Demon.dont: Disruption at wrong time, Soul Catcher miss, Purge on wrong target.
Shadow Demon.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min. Aghs for 3 Purge charges. Aether Lens for range.
Shadow Demon.gameStage: Early: lane harass with Shadow Poison, Disruption saves. Mid: Disruption+Soul Catcher kills. Late: Disruption creates strong illusions of enemy carry.

Shadow Fiend.goal: Dominate mid with Razes, stack souls for damage, minus armor with Presence, Requiem burst.
Shadow Fiend.requires: Win mid lane, maintain soul count, Raze accuracy, early tower pressure.
Shadow Fiend.fights: Requiem in fights (or Eul's combo), Raze for damage/stacks, right-click with souls+items.
Shadow Fiend.dont: Die and lose souls, miss Razes in fights, position for Requiem without BKB/setup.
Shadow Fiend.timings: Eul's 12-13min for solo kill combo. BKB 18-20min. Desolator for physical build.
Shadow Fiend.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Razes, stack camps. Mid: take mid tower, rotate with Requiem. Late: high physical damage carry or magic burst build.

Shadow Shaman.goal: Push towers with Serpent Wards, Shackle lockdown, Hex disable, Ether Shock nuke.
Shadow Shaman.requires: Shackle channel positioning, Ward placement on buildings, disable chain.
Shadow Shaman.fights: Hex+Shackle chain disable, drop Wards on towers/in fights, Ether Shock for AoE.
Shadow Shaman.dont: Wards in open field, Shackle without vision, get interrupted during Shackle.
Shadow Shaman.timings: Blink 16-18min for initiation. Aghs for Wards on shorter CD. Refresher for double Wards.
Shadow Shaman.gameStage: Early: push lane with Ether Shock, disable for kills. Mid: Ward push towers aggressively. Late: Refresher double Ward siege.

Silencer.goal: Global Silence stops all abilities, Intelligence steal on kills, Glaives pure damage.
Silencer.requires: Global Silence timing (counter big ults), Arcane Curse for harass, Last Word silence.
Silencer.fights: Global Silence to cancel enemy initiation/ults, Glaives for pure damage DPS.
Silencer.dont: Global Silence too early (before enemy uses spells), waste Arcane Curse, position forward.
Silencer.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min for utility. Refresher for double Global Silence.
Silencer.gameStage: Early: harass with Glaives, steal INT on kills. Mid: Global Silence counters teamfight ults. Late: INT steal makes you stronger, double Silence.

Skywrath Mage.goal: Arcane Bolt spam, Ancient Seal silence+magic amp, Concussive Shot slow, Mystic Flare burst.
Skywrath Mage.requires: Seal before Mystic Flare (magic amp), Flare on single isolated targets, mana management.
Skywrath Mage.fights: Seal priority target, Mystic Flare when isolated, Bolt spam, Concussive for slow.
Skywrath Mage.dont: Mystic Flare on grouped enemies (damage splits), Seal wrong target, run out of mana.
Skywrath Mage.timings: Rod of Atos 12-14min for Mystic Flare setup. Aghs for longer Flare.
Skywrath Mage.gameStage: Early: harass with Bolt spam, Seal for kills. Mid: Atos+Seal+Flare combo kills. Late: Seal+Flare on isolated targets.

Slardar.goal: Amplify damage with Corrosive Haze (armor reduction), Blink+Crush initiation, bash with Bash of the Deep.
Slardar.requires: Blink timing, Haze on priority physical damage targets, Sprint for mobility.
Slardar.fights: Blink+Crush stun, Haze enemy carry for armor reduction, bash with attacks.
Slardar.dont: Haze magic damage heroes, Crush without follow-up, Sprint into danger without Blink.
Slardar.timings: Blink 10-12min, BKB 18-20min. Haze is the key value — apply it early in fights.
Slardar.gameStage: Early: offlane with bash harass. Mid: Blink initiation, Haze for Roshan. Late: reliable initiator, Haze amplifies team's physical damage.

Slark.goal: Essence Shift steals stats permanently per fight, Shadow Dance regen/invis, Pounce leash, Dark Pact purge.
Slark.requires: Dark Pact purge timing, Pounce accuracy, Shadow Dance to regen, steal stats in extended fights.
Slark.fights: Dark Pact purge debuffs, Pounce to leash, Shadow Dance to regen and go invis, steal stats over time.
Slark.dont: Fight short engagements (need time to steal stats), Pounce miss, Dark Pact when full HP.
Slark.timings: Diffusal 14-16min, BKB/Shadow Blade 18-20min. Slark loves long fights for stat steal.
Slark.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Pounce kills. Mid: pick-offs with Shadow Dance, snowball. Late: stat steal makes you a monster in long fights.

Snapfire.goal: Mortimer Kisses long range AoE, Firesnap Cookie ally jump+stun, Lil' Shredder for attack slow.
Snapfire.requires: Cookie targeting (jump ally or self for stun), Mortimer Kisses aim, Lil' Shredder timing.
Snapfire.fights: Cookie ally for initiation/save, Mortimer Kisses from distance, Lil' Shredder for DPS.
Snapfire.dont: Mortimer Kisses close range (can't aim), Cookie miss, Lil' Shredder wrong target.
Snapfire.timings: Force Staff/Glimmer 14-16min. Aghs for Gobble Up ally launch.
Snapfire.gameStage: Early: Cookie+Shredder kills in lane, harass. Mid: Mortimer Kisses teamfights. Late: utility save with Cookie, long range Kisses.

Sniper.goal: Longest attack range in game, Headshot mini-stun harass, Assassinate for finishing kills.
Sniper.requires: Positioning (no escape), team protection, Shrapnel for vision/slow/damage.
Sniper.fights: Stay max range, Shrapnel for zone control, Headshot procs, Assassinate low HP heroes.
Sniper.dont: Position forward, skip Hurricane Pike (no escape), fight without vision.
Sniper.timings: Dragon Lance 10-12min, Pike 14-16min, Maelstrom/Mjollnir for farm.
Sniper.gameStage: Early: harass with range advantage. Mid: siege towers with Shrapnel, Take Aim range. Late: glass cannon, needs team to frontline.

Spectre.goal: Late game monster — Haunt to join fights globally, Desolate pure damage, Dispersion reflects damage.
Spectre.requires: Farm until items, survive lane, team creates space, Haunt to join fights.
Spectre.fights: Haunt into fights, Reality to right target, Desolate isolated targets, Dispersion tanks damage.
Spectre.dont: Fight before Radiance, Haunt without team fighting, Reality wrong target.
Spectre.timings: Radiance 18-22min, Manta 26-28min. Spectre is the HARDEST late game carry — don't end early.
Spectre.gameStage: Early: survive lane, get farm. Mid: Haunt to join fights, Radiance farm. Late: unkillable carry with Dispersion+items.

Spirit Breaker.goal: Global ganker with Charge of Darkness, bash through BKB, Nether Strike burst.
Spirit Breaker.requires: Charge target selection, bash luck, team follow-up on Charge.
Spirit Breaker.fights: Charge priority target across map, Greater Bash through BKB, Nether Strike for burst.
Spirit Breaker.dont: Charge into 5 heroes, Charge without vision, skip Shadow Blade/BKB.
Spirit Breaker.timings: Shadow Blade 12-14min for Charge+invis, BKB 18-20min. Charge ganks constantly.
Spirit Breaker.gameStage: Early: roam with Charge ganks constantly. Mid: global presence, Charge picks. Late: BKB-piercing bash, Nether Strike burst.

Storm Spirit.goal: Zip across the map with Ball Lightning, pick off heroes, snowball with mana items.
Storm Spirit.requires: Mana management, kill potential at level 6, Orchid/Kaya timing for pickoffs.
Storm Spirit.fights: Zip onto backline, Orchid silence + burst, Overload for damage between spells.
Storm Spirit.dont: Zip with no mana remaining, fight without mana items, ignore BKB timing.
Storm Spirit.timings: Orchid/Kaya 14-16min for kill potential. BKB 22-24min. Bloodstone for sustain.
Storm Spirit.gameStage: Early: farm mid, hit level 6 power spike. Mid: zip ganks across map, snowball. Late: pick-off machine, initiate on key targets.

Sven.goal: Cleave entire teams with God's Strength, Storm Hammer stun, Warcry armor/speed.
Sven.requires: BKB for uninterrupted hits, farm speed with cleave, God's Strength uptime in fights.
Sven.fights: BKB+God's Strength, Storm Hammer to initiate/stun, cleave through the whole team.
Sven.dont: Fight without God's Strength, get kited without BKB, Storm Hammer from max range and miss.
Sven.timings: Echo Sabre 12-14min, BKB 18-20min, Daedalus 26-28min for one-shot potential.
Sven.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane with cleave. Mid: God's Strength fights, take Roshan. Late: one-shot teams with crit+cleave.

Techies.goal: Proximity Mines for area denial, Blast Off for AoE silence, Reactive Tazer for defense.
Techies.requires: Mine placement for zoning, Blast Off timing, Sticky Bomb slow.
Techies.fights: Mines for zone control, Blast Off for AoE silence, Sticky Bomb slow for chase.
Techies.dont: Mines in obvious spots, Blast Off into 5 enemies, skip mine defense.
Techies.timings: Eul's 12-14min for setup, Aether Lens for range. Aghs Shard.
Techies.gameStage: Early: mine rune spots, Blast Off kills. Mid: mine key areas, push with team. Late: mine high ground defense, zone control.

Templar Assassin.goal: Meld strike armor reduction, Refraction damage block, Psi Blades spill, trap vision/slow.
Templar Assassin.requires: Refraction management, Meld positioning, farm speed for Desolator timing.
Templar Assassin.fights: Meld strike for armor reduction, Refraction for survival+damage, Psi Blade spill through targets.
Templar Assassin.dont: Fight with Refraction on cooldown, get DoT'd (removes charges fast), miss Meld strikes.
Templar Assassin.timings: Desolator 14-16min, Blink 20-22min for Meld Strike initiation. BKB when needed.
Templar Assassin.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Refraction, deny+last hit. Mid: Desolator Roshan, burst pickoffs. Late: physical burst, Meld one-shots.

Terrorblade.goal: Metamorphosis ranged form for push/damage, Conjure Image illusions, Sunder HP swap, Reflection slow. Illusions heavily nerfed in 7.40 (damage reduced to 20-35%).
Terrorblade.requires: Metamorphosis timing (push towers), illusion management, Sunder for survival. Dark Unity now gives 60% damage buff within 1200 range.
Terrorblade.fights: Metamorphosis for ranged DPS, Sunder when low HP to heal, Reflection to slow. Keep illusions within 1200 range for Dark Unity bonus.
Terrorblade.dont: Sunder too late (dead), Metamorphosis without target, illusions into AoE. Conjure Image damage significantly nerfed — don't rely on illusion DPS alone.
Terrorblade.timings: Dragon Lance 10-12min, Skadi/Eye of Skadi 20-22min. Push towers during every Metamorphosis. Stat items over Diffusal.
Terrorblade.gameStage: Early: farm with illusions (weaker now). Mid: Meta push towers, Sunder for survival. Late: ranged carry with Meta, Sunder clutch. Weaker illusion hero this patch.

Tidehunter.goal: Ravage is one of the best teamfight ults, Kraken Shell removes debuffs, Anchor Smash reduces damage.
Tidehunter.requires: Blink for multi-hero Ravage, survive lane, Anchor Smash damage reduction.
Tidehunter.fights: Blink+Ravage on 3+ heroes, Anchor Smash to reduce enemy carry damage, tank with Kraken Shell.
Tidehunter.dont: Ravage one hero, waste Ravage when team can't follow up, skip Blink.
Tidehunter.timings: Blink 14-16min, Refresher 28-30min for double Ravage. Ravage timing wins games.
Tidehunter.gameStage: Early: survive offlane, Anchor Smash to farm. Mid: Blink Ravage teamfights. Late: Refresher double Ravage, frontline tank.

Timbersaw.goal: Pure damage nukes that cut trees, reactive armor for tankiness, Whirling Death STR reduce.
Timbersaw.requires: Tree positioning for Timber Chain, reactive armor stacking, Chakram for sustained damage.
Timbersaw.fights: Timber Chain through trees for mobility, Chakram for AoE pure damage, Whirling Death STR reduce.
Timbersaw.dont: Fight without trees nearby, get silenced (can't cast), skip Bloodstone/Lotus.
Timbersaw.timings: Bloodstone 14-16min for mana sustain, Lotus Orb for dispel. Kaya+Sange for tank.
Timbersaw.gameStage: Early: dominate offlane with reactive armor + nukes. Mid: unkillable in trees, pure damage. Late: sustained pure damage, needs trees.

Tinker.goal: Infinite spell spam with Rearm, global presence with BoTs, Defense Matrix for ally saves.
Tinker.requires: Mana management, BoTs timing, Laser+Missile+Rearm combo execution, map awareness.
Tinker.fights: Stay far back, spam Laser+Missile+Rearm, Defense Matrix key ally, BoTs to split push.
Tinker.dont: March into dangerous areas, Rearm without mana, BoTs to wrong lane, get caught between Rearms.
Tinker.timings: BoTs 10-12min, Blink 16-18min, Overwhelming Blink for burst.
Tinker.gameStage: Early: farm mid with Laser+Missile. Mid: BoTs ganks, split push. Late: perma-push lanes, spam from distance.

Tiny.goal: Burst combo with Avalanche+Toss, flex pick (mid/offlane/support), grow into building destroyer.
Tiny.requires: Combo execution, Blink for initiation, flex draft advantage. Tree Grab for cleave damage.
Tiny.fights: Avalanche+Toss combo for burst, Blink initiation, right-click with Grow bonus damage.
Tiny.dont: Toss allies into enemies accidentally, miss Avalanche timing with Toss, fight without Tree.
Tiny.timings: Blink 12-14min (core) or 18-20min (support). Echo Sabre for attack speed.
Tiny.gameStage: Early: burst kill potential at level 3 with combo. Mid: Blink ganks, push towers. Late: building destroyer, high physical damage.

Treant Protector.goal: Living Armor global heal+block, Overgrowth roots entire team, Nature's Guise invis near trees.
Treant Protector.requires: Living Armor timing, Overgrowth placement, tree manipulation with Eyes in the Forest.
Treant Protector.fights: Overgrowth when enemy clumps, Living Armor allies globally, Nature's Guise for positioning.
Treant Protector.dont: Late Living Armor, Overgrowth on one hero, forget Eyes in the Forest vision.
Treant Protector.timings: Blink 16-18min for Overgrowth, or Meteor Hammer for push. Aghs for Eyes in the Forest map control.
Treant Protector.gameStage: Early: roam with Nature's Guise, Living Armor saves globally. Mid: Overgrowth teamfights, heal towers. Late: Aghs map vision, Overgrowth roots.

Troll Warlord.goal: Battle Trance for max attack speed, switch melee/ranged, Whirling Axes for miss/slow, Fervor stacking.
Troll Warlord.requires: Battle Trance target (locks on), melee/ranged switching, Fervor stacks on single target.
Troll Warlord.fights: Battle Trance onto priority target, Fervor stack for DPS, Whirling Axes for utility.
Troll Warlord.dont: Battle Trance wrong target, switch forms unnecessarily, fight without Fervor stacks.
Troll Warlord.timings: BKB 16-18min, Diffusal/Basher 20-22min. Battle Trance + Roshan is easy.
Troll Warlord.gameStage: Early: lane with range form, switch melee for bash. Mid: Roshan with Battle Trance, fight. Late: sustained DPS carry, Battle Trance burst.

Tusk.goal: Snowball to save allies or gank, Walrus Punch crit, Ice Shards to trap, Tag Team slow.
Tusk.requires: Snowball saves (bring ally inside), Ice Shards placement, Walrus Punch timing.
Tusk.fights: Snowball to save or initiate, Ice Shards to trap, Walrus Punch for burst, Tag Team slow.
Tusk.dont: Snowball allies into danger, Ice Shards block ally escape, Walrus Punch early (waste crit).
Tusk.timings: Blink/Shadow Blade 14-16min, Desolator for Walrus Punch burst. Solar Crest utility.
Tusk.gameStage: Early: roam with Snowball ganks, Ice Shards kills. Mid: pickoffs with Walrus Punch. Late: save allies with Snowball, utility role.

Underlord.goal: Firestorm wave clear, Pit of Malice root, Atrophy Aura damage reduce+steal, Dark Rift global TP.
Underlord.requires: Firestorm for lane push, Pit placement, Atrophy Aura stacking, Dark Rift timing.
Underlord.fights: Firestorm for AoE, Pit to root grouped enemies, Atrophy steal damage, Dark Rift to save/relocate team.
Underlord.dont: Dark Rift too late, Pit miss, Atrophy stacks wasted by dying.
Underlord.timings: Pipe/Crimson 14-16min for team utility, Guardian Greaves for sustain.
Underlord.gameStage: Early: dominate offlane with Firestorm, push waves. Mid: push with aura, Dark Rift splits. Late: aura tank, Dark Rift for team repositioning.

Undying.goal: Decay steals STR, Tombstone spawns zombies that slow, Flesh Golem amps damage and heals.
Undying.requires: Decay stacking in lane, Tombstone placement, Flesh Golem timing.
Undying.fights: Tombstone in fights (hard to kill), Decay steal STR, Flesh Golem for amp/heal.
Undying.dont: Tombstone in bad position (gets killed), fight without Flesh Golem, skip Decay stacking.
Undying.timings: Holy Locket for heal amp, Mekansm for team. Tombstone fights are your power.
Undying.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Decay STR steal. Mid: Tombstone teamfights, Flesh Golem push. Late: aura/utility hero, Tombstone placement wins fights.

Ursa.goal: Fury Swipes stacking damage melts single targets, Overpower for attack speed burst, Enrage damage reduction.
Ursa.requires: Gap close (Blink/Abyssal), Fury Swipes on single target, Enrage timing, early Roshan.
Ursa.fights: Blink+Overpower+Fury Swipes burst, Enrage to survive burst, Earthshock slow.
Ursa.dont: Get kited, fight multiple targets (single target hero), Enrage too late, skip Blink.
Ursa.timings: Blink 12-14min, Basher/Abyssal 20-22min. Early Roshan with Fury Swipes is free.
Ursa.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Fury Swipes, solo Roshan. Mid: Blink burst kills. Late: Abyssal lock+Fury Swipes burst, Enrage sustain.

Vengeful Spirit.goal: Swap saves or initiates, Wave of Terror armor reduce, Magic Missile stun, Vengeance Aura damage.
Vengeful Spirit.requires: Swap positioning (save carry or swap enemy in), aura value, stun follow-up.
Vengeful Spirit.fights: Swap enemy carry into team or save allied carry, stun priority targets, armor reduce with Wave.
Vengeful Spirit.dont: Swap yourself into 5 enemies, waste Magic Missile on creeps, position too far from carry.
Vengeful Spirit.timings: Force Staff 14-16min for double save (swap+force). Aghs for Swap range.
Vengeful Spirit.gameStage: Early: lane harass with Wave, stun for kills. Mid: smoke ganks, Swap pickoffs. Late: save carry with Swap, aura value.

Venomancer.goal: DoT damage everywhere — Poison Nova, Plague Wards for vision/push, Gale for slow.
Venomancer.requires: Ward placement for vision/push, Gale accuracy, Poison Nova timing.
Venomancer.fights: Poison Nova in teamfight, Gale to slow, Wards for DPS. Everything stacks poison.
Venomancer.dont: Wards in useless spots, Nova on 1 hero, fight without Wards pre-placed.
Venomancer.timings: Veil 12-14min for magic amp. Aghs for Poison Nova damage. Spirit Vessel synergy.
Venomancer.gameStage: Early: zone with Plague Wards, Gale harass. Mid: push towers with Wards, Nova fights. Late: massive DoT teamfighter.

Viper.goal: Lane dominator, Nethertoxin breaks passives, Corrosive Skin punishes attackers, Viper Strike slows.
Viper.requires: Win lane hard, push advantage early, Nethertoxin placement for break.
Viper.fights: Nethertoxin break key passives, Viper Strike priority target, tank with Corrosive Skin.
Viper.dont: Lose lane (hero's entire purpose), skip push timing, let game go too late.
Viper.timings: Dragon Lance 10-12min, early Roshan with team. Falls off late — end by 30min.
Viper.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Poison Attack. Mid: take towers, break passives with Nethertoxin. Late: falls off hard, end early.

Visage.goal: Familiars stun in AoE, Grave Chill slows, Gravekeeper's Cloak damage resist, Soul Assumption nuke.
Visage.requires: Familiar micro (stun+resummon), Soul Assumption stacks, Grave Chill targets.
Visage.fights: Familiar stuns, Soul Assumption burst, Grave Chill slow priority target.
Visage.dont: Familiars die without using stun, Soul Assumption without stacks, skip Familiar micro.
Visage.timings: Medallion/Solar Crest for armor reduce, Aghs for 3rd Familiar. Familiar stun resets are key.
Visage.gameStage: Early: dominate lane with Familiars, Soul Assumption burst. Mid: push towers with Familiars. Late: Familiar stuns in fights, Solar Crest buff carry.

Void Spirit.goal: Astral Step remnant dash, Dissimilate dodge, Resonant Pulse shield, Aether Remnant pull.
Void Spirit.requires: Astral Step combos, Dissimilate timing (dodge spells), Resonant Pulse shield management.
Void Spirit.fights: Astral Step in and out, Dissimilate to dodge key spell, Remnant for pull, Pulse for shield.
Void Spirit.dont: Use all Astral Step charges offensively (no escape), Dissimilate too early, Pulse without enemies.
Void Spirit.timings: Witch Blade/Orchid 12-14min, Aghs Shard. Eul's for setup.
Void Spirit.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Remnant+Pulse. Mid: Astral Step ganks, high mobility. Late: elusive burst damage, Astral Step in/out.

Warlock.goal: Fatal Bonds spreads damage across enemies, Chaotic Offering stuns with Golem, Shadow Word heal/damage.
Warlock.requires: Fatal Bonds before team damage, Golem placement, Shadow Word timing.
Warlock.fights: Fatal Bonds 3+ heroes, Golem stun into AoE, Shadow Word heal carry or damage priority.
