Warlock.dont: Golem without Fatal Bonds, Shadow Word wrong target, Bonds on single target.
Warlock.timings: Aghs 25-28min for double Golem. Refresher for quad Golem. Holy Locket for heals.
Warlock.gameStage: Early: sustain lane with Shadow Word, harass with Bonds. Mid: Fatal Bonds teamfights, Golem stun. Late: Refresher Golem army.

Weaver.goal: Time Lapse undoes damage, Shukuchi for invis/speed/damage, Geminate Attack double hit.
Weaver.requires: Time Lapse timing (survive burst in 5s window), Shukuchi weaving, Linken's for protection.
Weaver.fights: Shukuchi in/out, Geminate Attack procs, Time Lapse when bursted, The Swarm armor reduce.
Weaver.dont: Time Lapse too late (dead), fight without Shukuchi, skip Linken's (need it to Time Lapse).
Weaver.timings: Maelstrom 12-14min, Linken's 16-18min. Desolator for burst with Geminate.
Weaver.gameStage: Early: harass with Shukuchi+Geminate. Mid: pickoffs with Shukuchi, Time Lapse survival. Late: elusive carry, Time Lapse sustain.

Windranger.goal: Shackle for long stuns, Focus Fire to melt single targets, Powershot for harass/wave clear.
Windranger.requires: Shackle angles (latch to tree/unit), Focus Fire target priority, Windrun for survival.
Windranger.fights: Shackle priority targets, Focus Fire the carry, Windrun to dodge right-clicks.
Windranger.dont: Shackle without latch target, Focus Fire tanks, forget Powershot for scouting.
Windranger.timings: Javelin/Maelstrom 12-14min for Focus Fire damage. MKB for scaling.
Windranger.gameStage: Early: harass with Powershot, Shackle kills. Mid: pick-offs with Shackle+Focus Fire. Late: burst single targets, evasion with Windrun.

Winter Wyvern.goal: Winter's Curse makes enemies attack their own ally, Cold Embrace freezes and heals, Arctic Burn for range/slow.
Winter Wyvern.requires: Curse target selection (enemies attack the cursed ally), Cold Embrace timing, Arctic Burn poke.
Winter Wyvern.fights: Curse their carry (team kills their own carry), Cold Embrace to save allies, Arctic Burn for slow.
Winter Wyvern.dont: Curse when no enemies nearby to attack, Cold Embrace against magic burst (they still take magic damage), Splinter Blast wrong target.
Winter Wyvern.timings: Glimmer/Force 14-16min. Aghs for longer Curse, Holy Locket for Embrace heal.
Winter Wyvern.gameStage: Early: Arctic Burn harass, Splinter Blast push. Mid: Curse teamfight wins. Late: Curse is game-changing, Cold Embrace saves.

Witch Doctor.goal: Maledict amplifies burst damage, Death Ward channels massive DPS, Paralyzing Cask bounces.
Witch Doctor.requires: Maledict timing (before burst), Death Ward positioning, Cask bounces in small groups.
Witch Doctor.fights: Cask to stun, Maledict before team bursts, Death Ward from safe position/fog.
Witch Doctor.dont: Death Ward in open (get stunned), Maledict after damage is done, Cask into creep waves.
Witch Doctor.timings: Glimmer Cape 14-16min for safe Death Ward. Aghs for Death Ward bounce.
Witch Doctor.gameStage: Early: harass with Cask+Maledict, kill pressure. Mid: Maledict+team burst, Death Ward fights. Late: Glimmer+BKB Death Ward, Maledict priority targets.

Wraith King.goal: Two lives with Reincarnation, reliable stun, crit for damage, skeletons for push.
Wraith King.requires: Mana for Reincarnation (get mana burned = dead), farm speed, Radiance timing.
Wraith King.fights: Walk at enemies, stun priority target, Reincarnation slow after second life.
Wraith King.dont: Get mana burned/drained before dying, fight without Reincarnation mana, skip BKB.
Wraith King.timings: Radiance 16-18min or Armlet 10-12min. Blink for initiation.
Wraith King.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, Skeleton harass. Mid: Radiance farm, push with skeletons. Late: unkillable frontline, Reincarnation forces enemy to fight twice.

Zeus.goal: Global burst with Thundergod's Wrath, Arc Lightning for lane/farm, Bolt for damage+vision.
Zeus.requires: Mana sustain, positioning (squishy), level advantage for burst potential.
Zeus.fights: Stay back, spam Bolt+Arc Lightning, Wrath to finish low heroes or initiate fights.
Zeus.dont: Walk forward in fights, skip Aether Lens/mobility, Wrath on full HP enemies.
Zeus.timings: Aether Lens 12-14min, Aghs 22-25min for Nimbus. Refresher for double Wrath.
Zeus.gameStage: Early: dominate mid with Arc Lightning spam. Mid: gank with Bolt, global Wrath kills. Late: Nimbus+Refresher teamfight dominance.
